TruncateText.description: Truncate text to a maximum length.

AddTextPrefix.description: Add a prefix to all texts.

AddTextSuffix.description: Add a suffix to all texts.

StripWhitespace.description: Strip leading and trailing whitespace from all texts.

ShuffleDataset.description: Randomly shuffle the order of images in a list.

ShuffleImageTextDataset.description: Randomly shuffle the order of pairs of image-text in a list.

ImageDeduplication.description: Remove duplicate or very similar images from a list.

interface.doc: Similarity threshold (0-1). Higher means more similar. Images above this threshold are considered duplicates.

ImageGrid.description: Arrange multiple images into a grid layout.

MergeTextLists.description: Concatenate multiple text lists into one.

ComfyNotNode.description: Logical NOT operation. Returns true if the value is falsy. Uses Python's rules for truthiness.

ComfyAndNode.description: Logical AND operation. Returns true if all of the values are truthy. Uses Python's rules for truthiness.

ComfyOrNode.description: Logical OR operation. Returns true if any of the values are truthy. Uses Python's rules for truthiness.

ModelMergeWAN2_1.description: 1.3B model has 30 blocks, 14B model has 40 blocks. Image to video model has the extra img_emb.

interface.doc: Absolute training noise scale. For example HiDream-O1 base: 8.0, dev: 7.5.

ModelAttentionBackend.description: Selects the dense attention implementation for the model. When used with Block Sparse Attention, this backend is used whenever sparse attention is inactive or unsupported.

interface.doc: The dense attention backend. Comfy Kitchen attention uses quantized INT8 attention and is available only on Nvidia and AMD GPUs.
The model with the selected attention backend.

ScaleROPE.description: Scale and shift the ROPE of the model.

EmptyHiDreamO1LatentImage.description: Empty pixel-space latent for HiDream-O1-Image. The model was trained at ~4 megapixels; lower resolutions go off-distribution and quality regresses noticeably. Trained resolutions: 2048x2048, 2304x1728, 1728x2304, 2560x1440, 1440x2560, 2496x1664, 1664x2496, 3104x1312, 1312x3104, 2304x1792, 1792x2304.

CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.

interface.doc: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.
A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.

CLIPTextEncodePixArtAlpha.description: Encodes text and sets the resolution conditioning for PixArt Alpha. Does not apply to PixArt Sigma.

CLIPTextEncodeLumina2.description: Encodes a system prompt and a user prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.

ReferenceLatent.description: This node sets the guiding latent for an edit model. If the model supports it you can chain multiple to set multiple reference images.

StableCascade_StageC_VAEEncode.displayName: Stable Cascade Stage C VAE Encode

ResizeImageMaskNode.description: Resize an image or mask using various scaling methods.

inputs.doc: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.
How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

interface.doc: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.
Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

ColorTransfer.description: Match the colors of one image to another using various algorithms.

Reference image(s) to match colors to.
